newsitem.title: UK: BP sees "self help" savings exceed 97 target.
newsitem.headline: BP sees "self help" savings exceed 97 target.

text.p: British Petroleum Co Plc said so-called self-help savings this year will likely exceed the 1997 target of $300 million.
"I expect it will be higher," finance director John Buchanan told journalists after BP earlier reported a 19 percent profit increase in 1997's first quarter.
Self-help savings, stemming from cost-cutting and volume growth, totalled $120 million in the first three months of the year.
Buchanan said he expected net overall savings for BP from its European downstream venture with Mobil Corp to start coming in in the second half of this year at between $50 million to $100 million.
